newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-HILL AND GRAYSON NAMED IN ENGLAND TEAM.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-HILL AND GRAYSON NAMED IN ENGLAND TEAM.

text.p: England named Saracens' flanker Richard Hill and recalled fly-half Paul Grayson on Monday in the team for their Five Nations' championship opener against Scotland at Twickenham on February 1.
Tim Rodber moves from the side of the scrum to number eight in place of Chris Sheasby with Lawrence Dallaglio switching to blindside flanker. Grayson takes over from Mike Catt.
Former captain Will Carling has been retained as skipper Phil de Glanville's centre partner.

England - Tim Stimpson; Jon Sleightholme, Will Carling, Phil de Glanville (captain), Tony Underwood; Paul Grayson, Andy Gomarsall; Tim Rodber, Richard Hill, Lawrence Dallaglio, Simon Shaw, Martin Johnson, Jason Leonard, Mark Regan, Graham Rowntree.
